Coordinates from OSM. Verified as a real, distinct Greek swimmable beach by adversarial web check (>6168m from any existing beach). Google confirms a beach (21 ratings) 7m from the pin. Slot via nearest existing beach #261 (6168m). Access/terrain unknown — needs field verification.

Water depth from EMODnet bathymetry 2026-08-25: 9.63 m at 100 m offshore on the E bearing (beach faces 102.8°), profile confidence high. Above the national p75 of 5.9 m, so the water is demonstrably not shallow; recorded as "medium". Bathymetry can prove the steep side only, never the shallow one — no "shallow" is ever written from it. Previously the field was absent and the app inferred depth from shore surface. No other field changed.
